title: IAMMAI First-Pass Contribution Role Record
description: First-pass schema for one contribution-role record. This object is small, explicit, and implementation-facing. It preserves typed participation relation to material without collapsing into generic authorship, governance action, witness, validation, state, transition, identity infrastructure, or runtime authority.

contribution_role_record_id.description: Bounded identifier for this one contribution-role record object. It makes the preserved role relation referable without implying a final global identity system or settled runtime admission.

recorded_at.description: Recorded-at value for when this contribution-role relation was explicitly housed as a record. This remains a conservative non-empty string rather than a frozen final timestamp model.

role_type.description: Typed contribution role preserved for the bounded relation to matter. This remains narrower than generic authorship and does not promote contribution role into governance or identity.

matter_ref.description: Bounded reference to the material or matter to which the typed contribution role relates. This keeps the role record tied to material participation rather than free-floating labels.

actor_ref.description: Optional bounded reference to an actor related to the preserved contribution role where that relation is relevant. This does not by itself settle final identity binding.

artifact_ref.description: Optional bounded reference to an artifact related to the preserved contribution role where that relation is relevant. This keeps artifact relation explicit without collapsing contribution into artifact ownership.

related_governance_action_ref.description: Optional bounded reference to a related governance action where such relation is relevant. This preserves distinction from governance by keeping governance relation explicit rather than absorbed.
